iti88:2.1: (Tik. IV.) Tayo-me bhikkhave antarā malā antarā amittā antarā sapattā antarā vadhakā antarā paccatthikā. Katame tayo? Lobho bhikkhave antarā malo antarā amitto antarā sapatto antarā vadhako antarā paccatthiko. Doso bhikkhave antarā malo antarā amitto antarā sapatto antarā vadhako antarā paccatthiko. Moho bhikkhave antarā malo antarā amitto antarā sapatto antarā vadhako antarā paccatthiko. Ime kho bhikkhave tayo antarā malā antarā amittā antarā sapattā antarā vadhakā antarā paccatthikā ti. Anatthajanano lobho lobho cittappakopano | bhayam-antarato
iti88:4.1: Luddho atthaṃ na jānāti luddho dhammaṃ na passati | andhaṃ tamaṃ tadā hoti yaṃ lobho sahate naraṃ ||
iti88:5.1: Yo ca lobhaṃ pahantvāna lobhaneyye na lubbhati | lobho pahīyate tamhā udabindu va pokkharā ||
iti88:6.1: Anatthajanano doso doso cittappakopano | bhayam-antarato jātaṃ taṃ jano nāvabujjhati ||
iti88:7.1: Duṭṭho atthaṃ na jānāti duṭṭho dhammaṃ na passati | andhaṃ tamaṃ tadā hoti yaṃ doso sahate naraṃ ||
iti88:8.1: Yo ca dosaṃ pahantvāna dosaneyye na dussati | doso pahīyate tamhā tālapakkaṃ va bandhanā ||
iti88:9.1: Anatthajanano moho moho cittappakopano | bhayam-antarato jātaṃ taṃ jano nāvabujjhati ||
iti88:10.1: Mūḷho atthaṃ na jānāti mūḷho dhammaṃ na passati | andhaṃ tamaṃ tadā hoti yaṃ moho sahate naraṃ ||
iti88:11.1: Yo ca mohaṃ pahantvāna mohaneyye na muyhati | mohaṃ vihanti so sabbaṃ ādicco v-udayaṃ taman-ti ||9||
